title: The Sigil of the Glass Steppe
author: Felix Dunmore
blurb: Petra Voss, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
